name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.72.1 — review-legs.js reads the LAST match of testCountPattern/skipReportPattern over runner output, never the first: a test name quoting the summary phrase precedes the real summary line, and a quoted zero forced a false red suite row on a green run (specs/20260903/02-whole-suite-review-leg.md close record). 7.72.0 — review gains a blocking `suite` leg closing the `scoped-gate-blind-spot` escape class (specs/20260903/02-whole-suite-review-leg.md): `review-legs.js` runs the host's bare `testCommand` once per legs iteration in its own wave (1b, between gate/reconcile/ci and at-risk/patterns), writing `suite-output.txt` and a row typed like the gate's; `verdict.js`'s `REVIEW_LEGS`/`REVIEW_BLOCKING` and the review driver's `BLOCKING_LEGS` require it in both scopes, red derives `GATE_RED` before any reviewer spend, and the driver's close-time re-run widens to the same bare command so files CLOSE itself writes are covered. `spec/doctrine/replay-corpus.md` gains the derived `scoped-gate-blind-spot` section (nine classes total) and `.claude/spec.config.json` declares it inapplicable now that the leg is mechanized here. tests/review/review-legs.test.js, tests/review/review-legs-smoke-wave.test.js, tests/review/legs-verdict-pair.test.js, tests/review/verdict.test.js, tests/verdict-gatered-no-workflow.test.js, tests/provenance/provenance.test.js, tests/review/escalate-row.test.js, tests/consistency/red-fixture-coverage.test.js, tests/review/review-driver.test.js, tests/replay/replay-corpus.test.js. 7.70.0 — the fleet reader's ninth question, `owed`, lists every plugin-blaming row across this machine's checkouts (specs/20260903/01-owed-query-and-row-handoff.md): escape rows whose `preventedBy` is `review-check` or `runtime-leg`, missed replay rows, and unstamped `docs/spec-feedback/` findings, grouped by effective class with the joined recurrence count and a pointer to core § Incident Policy; fixed-status is derived from a citation scan over `specs/`, `spec/`, `tests/` in self-repair repos, never stored. `replay.js --record` gains `--via driver|manual` (stamped on the row and the artifact; `--stats` gains a `by-via` line); the review driver's REPLAY step and its `replay-recorded` refusal remedy both print `--via driver`. `escape-row.js --append` prints the derived row key on its confirmation line. Host doctrine: `escape.md` step 7 and `replay.md` Phase 5 report a plugin-blaming row's key with the sentence that the plugin repo's `fleet-reader --owed` consumes it — no handoff prompt is composed. tests/fleet-reader/owed.test.js, tests/fleet-reader/discovery.test.js, tests/replay/record-via.test.js, tests/review/review-driver.test.js, tests/escape/escape-row.test.js, tests/fleet-reader/doctrine-pins.test.js.
